021import com.vdurmont.semver4j.Semver;
022import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
023import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.utils.UpdateChecker;
024import org.json.simple.JSONObject;
025import org.json.simple.parser.JSONParser;
026import org.json.simple.parser.ParseException;
027
028import java.io.IOException;
029import java.net.URI;
030import java.net.http.HttpClient;
031import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
032import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
033import java.time.Duration;
034
035/**
036 * Updater
037 *
038 * @author creatorfromhell
039 * @since 0.1.2.0
040 */
041public class Updater extends UpdateChecker {
042
043  private static final URI RELEASE_ENDPOINT = URI.create(
044          "https://api.github.com/repos/BitworksMC/EconomyCore/releases/latest");
045  private static final Duration REQUEST_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(10);
046
047  final String ver;
048  final Semver releaseVersion;
049  final Semver pluginVersion;
050
051  public Updater() {
052
053    final String installedVersion = PluginCore.engine().version();
054    ver = latestRelease(installedVersion);
055    releaseVersion = new Semver(ver, Semver.SemverType.LOOSE);
056    pluginVersion = new Semver(installedVersion, Semver.SemverType.LOOSE);
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public boolean isEarlyBuild() {
061
062    return pluginVersion.compareTo(releaseVersion) > 0;
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public boolean needsUpdate() {
067
068    return releaseVersion.compareTo(pluginVersion) > 0;
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  public String stable() {
073
074    return stability(PluginCore.engine().version(), PluginCore.engine().build());
075  }
076
077  public static String stability(final String version, final String build) {
078
079    if(new Semver(version + "-" + build, Semver.SemverType.LOOSE).isStable()) {
080      return "Stable";
081    }
082    return "Not Stable";
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  public String getBuild() {
087
088    return ver;
089  }
090
091  private static String latestRelease(final String installedVersion) {
092
093    try {
094      return requestLatestRelease(installedVersion);
095    } catch(final InterruptedException e) {
096      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
097      logFailure(e);
098    } catch(final IOException | ParseException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
099      logFailure(e);
100    }
101    return installedVersion;
102  }
103
104  private static String requestLatestRelease(final String installedVersion)
105          throws IOException, InterruptedException, ParseException {
106
107    final HttpClient client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
108            .connectTimeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
109            .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NORMAL)
110            .build();
111    final HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(RELEASE_ENDPOINT)
112            .timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
113            .header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
114            .header("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
115            .header("User-Agent", "EconomyCore/" + installedVersion)
116            .GET()
117            .build();
118    final HttpResponse<String> response = client.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
119    if(response.statusCode() != 200) {
120      throw new IOException("GitHub returned HTTP " + response.statusCode());
121    }
122    return releaseTag(response.body());
123  }
124
125  private static String releaseTag(final String responseBody) throws ParseException {
126
127    final Object parsed = new JSONParser().parse(responseBody);
128    if(!(parsed instanceof JSONObject release)) {
129      throw new IllegalArgumentException("GitHub returned an unexpected response");
130    }
131    final Object tag = release.get("tag_name");
132    if(!(tag instanceof String) || ((String)tag).isBlank()) {
133      throw new IllegalArgumentException("GitHub release is missing tag_name");
134    }
135    final String version = ((String)tag).replaceFirst("^[vV]", "");
136    new Semver(version, Semver.SemverType.LOOSE);
137    return version;
138  }
139
140  private static void logFailure(final Exception exception) {
141
142    PluginCore.log().warning("Unable to check BitworksMC/EconomyCore GitHub releases: "
143                             + exception.getMessage());
144  }
145}
